logline: Defying Gerald and Clarissa's cruel mockery, Juliana accepts the mysterious scarred warrior's solemn proposal and is officially wed, choosing exile and dignity over her family's cruelty as they walk out into the light together.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 3's cliffhanger where the Mysterious Bearded Man dropped to one knee before the altar, presenting a ring to Lady Juliana.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man's scarred hand holding out the silver band ring.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana, staring down in disbelief at the offered ring.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana's eyes widen, stunned breath catching in her throat.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Gerald stepping forward from his pew with a smug, sneering grin.

segments.label: GERALD (Mocking, Arrogant)
segments.speaker: GERALD
segments.text: Look at him.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Gerald's venomous, self-satisfied face.

segments.label: GERALD (Scornful)
segments.speaker: GERALD
segments.text: A penniless nobody for a discarded bride.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Clarissa covering her mouth with her gloved hand, bursting into cruel laughter.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Clarissa giggles spitefully, lowering her gloved hand to gloat.

segments.label: CLARISSA (Gleeful, Condescending)
segments.speaker: CLARISSA
segments.text: How fitting.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot of Clarissa and Gerald standing proudly side-by-side in their pew as Clarissa points mocking fingers.

segments.label: CLARISSA (Taunting)
segments.speaker: CLARISSA
segments.text: You have finally found a man as worthless as everyone thinks you are.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's side profile, hurt glistening in her eyes as the insult cuts deep.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up toward the high arches of the chapel, drawing inward strength.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana closes her eyes briefly and releases a steadying breath.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot looking past the kneeling Mysterious Bearded Man up at Juliana.

segments.label: JULIANA (Vulnerable, Trembling)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You don't even know me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man gazing upward with unwavering earnestness.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Juliana's anguished face.

segments.label: JULIANA (Conflicted, Pained)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You heard what they think I am.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot looking down as Juliana addresses the kneeling stranger directly.

segments.label: JULIANA (Searching)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Why would you offer me your name?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man.

segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave, Certain)
segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
segments.text: Because I know what I see.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana reacting with a mix of suspicion and wonder.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Intimate tight shot framing Juliana's profile beside his dark silhouette.

segments.label: JULIANA (Quiet, Hesitant)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: And what do you see?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man.

segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Firm, Sincere)
segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
segments.text: A woman who was betrayed.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Over-the-shoulder shot past the bearded warrior toward Gerald watching nervously from the family pew.

segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Resolute)
segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
segments.text: Not a woman who deserves to be discarded.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium shot of Juliana bending slightly forward, shaken by his words.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana.

segments.label: JULIANA (Soft, Bitter)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You don't know what my family has done to me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man still on one knee, framed against the stained-glass window.

segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Solemn)
segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
segments.text: I know they have made you stand alone.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of the ring held in his weathered fingers, Juliana's white silk gown blurred in background.

segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Gentle)
segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
segments.text: You don't have to stand alone now.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana, her pride flaring through her sadness.

segments.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Dignified)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: If this is pity, take back your ring.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on Juliana's face, a tear clinging to her cheek.

segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I will not become anyone's charity.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man holding her gaze directly.

segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Earnest)
segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
segments.text: It is not pity, Lady Juliana.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Intense tight close-up on his piercing blue-green eyes and facial scars.

segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Deep, Absolute)
segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
segments.text: It is a vow.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana, completely disarmed by the gravity of his promise.

segments.label: JULIANA (V.O.)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I don't know this man.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Lady Ashcroft, Clarissa, and Lord Ashcroft seated coldly in the family pew.

segments.label: JULIANA (V.O.)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I don't know what waits beyond these doors.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Side profile close-up of Juliana looking toward her estranged family, then turning back.

segments.label: JULIANA (V.O.)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: But he looked at me when everyone else turned away.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana facing down at him, a faint, tender smile breaking across her lips.

segments.label: JULIANA (Resolved)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Then I accept.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of the altar with the high cathedral stained glass overhead as the Priest looks on between them.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man rising smoothly to his feet before Juliana.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Mysterious Bearded Man stands tall, extending his scarred hand toward Juliana.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's slender hand resting gently into his large, weathered palm.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: He folds his fingers over hers, holding her hand with protective firmness.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the Priest holding his open liturgical book, bewildered and trembling.

segments.label: THE PRIEST (Hesitant, Anxious)
segments.speaker: THE PRIEST
segments.text: My- My Lady...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of the Priest's alarmed, questioning eyes.

segments.label: THE PRIEST (Tentative)
segments.speaker: THE PRIEST
segments.text: Are you certain?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft seated in his pew, gripping his cane, bowed in grim silence.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up profile of Juliana, her expression clear and unshakable.

segments.label: JULIANA (Unwavering)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I am.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the Priest swallowing hard and looking down at his book.

segments.label: THE PRIEST (Resigned, Solemn)
segments.speaker: THE PRIEST
segments.text: Then... let us proceed.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close two-shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man and Juliana gazing intimately into each other's eyes.

segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Low, Reassuring)
segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
segments.text: You need not say anything you do not mean.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana smiling softly up at him.

segments.label: JULIANA (Warm, Sincere)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I truly mean it.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up shot of his hands sliding the silver ring over her ring finger.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Mysterious Bearded Man carefully slides the band onto Juliana's finger.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man holding her hands tenderly.

segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Solemn)
segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
segments.text: You have my protection.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight shot of the warrior's face, his eyes full of devotion.

segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Steadfast)
segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
segments.text: You have my respect.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of his intense gaze.

segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Grave)
segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
segments.text: And you have my word.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium three-shot with the Priest standing between them, raising both hands in blessing over their joined hands.

segments.label: THE PRIEST (Ceremonial)
segments.speaker: THE PRIEST
segments.text: By the authority entrusted to me, I now pronounce you...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: High wide establishing shot looking down from the ceiling vaults of the cathedral onto the altar.

segments.label: THE PRIEST (Off-Screen, Booming)
segments.speaker: THE PRIEST
segments.text: ...husband and wife!

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Dramatic musical chord swelling.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Gerald lunging forward, pointing an enraged finger.

segments.label: GERALD (Furious, Shouting)
segments.speaker: GERALD
segments.text: You have thrown yourself away!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Gerald, face contorted in rage.

segments.label: GERALD (Livid)
segments.speaker: GERALD
segments.text: For a penniless nobody!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot of Juliana standing tall before Gerald in the chapel aisle, her husband standing guard behind her.

segments.label: JULIANA (Calm, Cutting)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I would rather choose my own life...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana, her jaw set with unshakable pride.

segments.label: JULIANA (Firm, Final)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: ...than spend another moment begging for yours.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Gerald, eyes wide with speechless shock and wounded pride.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Gerald recoils slightly, mouth agape.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of Lady Ashcroft rising abruptly from the front pew, pointing an accusatory hand toward the doors.

segments.label: LADY ASHCROFT (Imperious, Shouting)
segments.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
segments.text: Do not bring this man anywhere near Ashcroft Manor!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Lady Ashcroft, eyes blazing with cold malice.

segments.label: LADY ASHCROFT (Venomous)
segments.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
segments.text: You are disowned!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft bowing his head deeply over his cane in shame.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana. Tears brim in her eyes at the formal rejection, but she does not break.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot as the Mysterious Bearded Man turns gently to Juliana, reaching his hand out once more.

segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Soft, Protective)
segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
segments.text: Come, Lady Juliana.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana placing her hand securely into his, gripping his scarred hand.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide tracking shot behind Juliana and the warrior as they begin walking down the central aisle toward the chapel doors.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium three-shot of Gerald, Clarissa, and Lady Ashcroft watching in stunned silence and disbelief.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Clarissa gapes in shock while Lady Ashcroft exhales in exasperation.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot from the back of the chapel as the massive oak doors swing wide open, revealing bright daylight and the courtyard outside.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man walk hand-in-hand through the towering doors into the sunlight together, turning their backs on the ruined wedding as the screen fades out.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Heavy oak doors creaking open, followed by a triumphant musical swell fading out into silence.

segments.text: Tight close-up of Lady Ashcroft, eyes blazing with cold malice.

segments.label: LADY ASHCROFT (Venomous)
segments.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
segments.text: You are disowned!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft bowing his head deeply over his cane in shame.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana. Tears brim in her eyes at the formal rejection, but she does not break.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot as the Mysterious Bearded Man turns gently to Juliana, reaching his hand out once more.

segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Soft, Protective)
segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
segments.text: Come, Lady Juliana.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana placing her hand securely into his, gripping his scarred hand.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide tracking shot behind Juliana and the warrior as they begin walking down the central aisle toward the chapel doors.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium three-shot of Gerald, Clarissa, and Lady Ashcroft watching in stunned silence and disbelief.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Clarissa gapes in shock while Lady Ashcroft exhales in exasperation.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot from the back of the chapel as the massive oak doors swing wide open, revealing bright daylight and the courtyard outside.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man walk hand-in-hand through the towering doors into the sunlight together, turning their backs on the ruined wedding as the screen fades out.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Heavy oak doors creaking open, followed by a triumphant musical swell fading out into silence.
